lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are distributed in a quasi-rectilinear grid posterior to the branchial region. These centroids are organized into distinct horizontal rows and vertical columns with relatively uniform spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the primary circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature with a sharp vertical luminance gradient—characterized by a high-intensity upper edge and a shadowed lower edge—runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular patch of high-luminance pixels, suggestive of a dermal abrasion or scar, is visible on the upper dorsal-lateral surface, positioned anterior to the primary grid pattern.
